source.parameterConvention: linear RGB BSDF times light-side cosine, sr^-1; unit incident radiance per solid angle
source.directionConvention: unit directions away from surface; normal +Z; view and signed light angles in XZ plane
source.threeComparison: self-authored CPU transcription of actual R05 vendored Three direct shader; no GPU measurement
source.displaySubset: View 0/30/60 degrees; light -60/-30/0/30/60; all three shared roughness settings and five coverage fractions. No interpolation is represented as original execution.

notes: opaque paint and steel coverage, one direct light, no environment/tone mapping/normal or geometry roughness. Three values are a CPU transcription, not a GPU measurement. Colors are R05 artistic inputs, not measured steel reflectance. Area mixing assumes unresolved side-by-side phases, not a transparent coating.
Main samples use the same roughness for both phases. extendedSamples separately uses original R05 paint .43 and steel .34 roughness.
phaseMixed=(1-coverage)*Adobe(dielectric)+coverage*Adobe(steel). parameterMixed=Adobe(mix(colors),metalness=coverage); all Adobe RGB values came from actual pinned implementation calls.

relativeError is RGB Euclidean norm(parameterMixed-phaseMixed)/max(norm(phaseMixed),1e-12). It measures mixing-order difference; it is not perceptual error, a rendered-pixel error, or proof that every material must be area-mixed.
RGB is linear. The unit is sr^-1 for BSDF times light cosine. Do not multiply the displayed reference by cosine a second time.
CPU Three comparison excludes environment, geometry roughness derivatives, normal perturbations, tone mapping and exposure. It does not validate the final R06 GPU adapter.
No measured material calibration is claimed; base_diffuse_roughness remains 0.

Contract tests pass representative nonzero cases; a fully zero-response boundary with default unused coat roughness=0 shows PDF consistency failures. See RESULT.md; no universal implementation correctness claim.
